channel.title: Askēsis — Philosophy, Reframed
channel.description: Short entries, argument cards, thought experiments and 60-second series. Edited, not encyclopedic.

item.title: Sartre's Bad Faith
item.description: You always have a choice — bad faith is pretending you don't.

item.title: On Free Will
item.description: Physics says causes. Morality says blame.

item.title: Qualia in Consciousness
item.description: Mary knows everything about colour — in a black-and-white room.

item.title: Rawls' Veil of Ignorance
item.description: Fair rules are the ones you'd pick before knowing your place.

item.title: Skeptical Theism and Evil
item.description: Evil is evidence against God — unless our ignorance is the evidence.

item.title: A-Theory of Time
item.description: Only now is real. The past is gone; the future isn't yet.

item.title: Descartes' Cogito
item.description: I think, therefore I am — the one sentence that survives doubt.

item.title: The Stoic Dichotomy
item.description: Control what you can. Release the rest.

item.title: Anselm's Ontological Argument
item.description: Can you define God into existence?
